parts.label: (a)
parts.text:
Opportunities for enterprise arise in a number of different ways, including:
• taking advantage of new technology
• taking advantage of the opportunities offered by globalisation
• recognising areas of expansion
• changes in taste and fashion.
Discuss how Shivani and Alison could use two of the opportunities listed above to develop
their board game enterprise in the future.

potential customers.

• the information available
• the time available
• who would be the most dominant participant.

enterprise project. Use examples to support your answer.
